title: polypodium lasiosorum
intro: Polypodium lasiosorum, commonly known as the Rock Polypody fern or Lasiosoria fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Polypodium lasiosorum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and preventing cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestive processes, regulate blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids.
